'''Durese''', also called '''Durosian''', was the native [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]].<ref name="u" />

Since the Duros were such prominent spacers and traders, Durese became a common interstellar tongue. It was an influence for [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]],<ref name="Gamer 2">{{GamerCite|2|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Duros}}</ref> and most Duros were fluent in both languages.<ref name="u" /> Most likely, it was also the root language of [[Pak Pak/Legends|Pak Pak]]. The Durese writing system was a syllabary.

==Feminine words used as given names==
The following words had a meaning in Durese, but could be used as given names for female Duros.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

*''Anra'' &ndash; laughter
*''Bechesmy'' &ndash; free thinker, wanderer (archaic)
*''Cyran'' &ndash; musical
*''Ena'' &ndash; regal, female ruler, queen (archaic)
*''Fullua'' &ndash; beloved
*''Gless'' &ndash; filled with joy
*''Hent'' &ndash; athletic
*''Izrin'' &ndash; beautiful
*''Ka'' &ndash; sky
*''Kiom'' &ndash; fresh air
*''Lai'' (m.) ''leshef'' (f.) - charismatic
*''Lod'' (m.) ''lona'' (f.) - wise
*''Mezerel'' &ndash; eclipse
*''nacha'' &ndash; fortune-teller, prophetess (archaic)
*''nuth'' &ndash; breathtaking
*''Onio'' &ndash; rain-bearing cloud (archaic)
*''Pleness'' &ndash; pure water
*''Quoia'' &ndash; evening star
*[[Rana Mas Trehalt|''Rana'']] &ndash; dark cloud
*''Remerel'' &ndash; graceful dancer
*''Rek ''(m.) ''ruz'' (f.) - intelligent
*''Treta'' - hostess (literally "female servant bearing food")
*''Tris'' &ndash; sad, crying
*''Vendi'' &ndash; desirable
*''Wirret'' &ndash; talkative
*''Yrna'' &ndash; beguiling

==Masculine words used as given names==
The following words had a meaning in Durese, but could be used as given names for male Duros.<ref name="GCG" />
*''Areta'' &ndash; industrious
*''Baniss'' &ndash; handsome
*''Bringe'' - honest
*''Cachi'' &ndash; gentle
*''Forim'' &ndash; capable, dependable
*''Gol'' &ndash; mighty
*''Hep'' &ndash; cunning
*''Izzed'' &ndash; entertaining
*''Jad'' &ndash; swift
*''Levat'' &ndash; restless, eager
*''Muz'' &ndash; hearty
*''Ohwun'' &ndash; famous
*''Plono'' &ndash; agreeable
*''Probos'' &ndash; inspiring
*''Quelben'' &ndash; bearer to the skies (reference to Duros diaspora)
*''Rumun'' &ndash; strong voice
*''Soz'' &ndash; an archaic melee weapon
*''Valik'' &ndash; blaster weapon
*''Winrel'' &ndash; trustworthy

==Words used as surnames==
The following words had a meaning in Durese, but were also used as surnames.<ref name="GCG" />
*''Arapto'' &ndash; swift
*''Bodge'' &ndash; merchant, trader
*''Chaggit'' &ndash; food processor
*''DeBrek'' &ndash; starship crafter
*''DeMaal'' &ndash; space station crafter
*''Erbek'' &ndash; pollution warden
*''Foll'' &ndash; priest (archaic)
*''Gigrig'' &ndash; gardener
*''Gubb'' &ndash; moutain
*''Hud'' &ndash; possibly "hunter" or "forester"
*''Inrull'' &ndash; heart
*''Jokol'' &ndash; factory worker
*''Keeg'' &ndash; fisher (archaic)
*''Kresim'' &ndash; researcher
*''Lakbret'' &ndash; airspeeder crafter
*''Losh'' &ndash; peace warden
*''Luk'' &ndash; pilot
*''Miklak'' &ndash; landspeeder crafter
*''Mulk'' &ndash; speaker, politician
*''Na Maak'' &ndash; atmospheric dome crafter
*''Nootka'' &ndash; supervisor, commander
*''Nuruk'' &ndash; soldier
*''Oulat'' &ndash; administrator
*''Pedd'' &ndash; farmer (archaic)
*''Renek'' &ndash; male ruler, king (archaic)
*''Riltka'' &ndash; metalsmith
*''Rurk'' &ndash; possibly 'sailor'
*''Slarka'' &ndash; baker
*''Tacema'' &ndash; pest control warden
*''Trenma'' &ndash; mechanic
*''Viridux'' - spacer
*''Woluk'' &ndash; tunnel-digger, miner (archaic)

==Other words==
*''Esalacha'' - excellent
*''[[Ranadaast]]'' - unclear, but this seems to be derived from "Rana" and was the name of the old capital of Duro.
